newsitem.title: THAILAND: Electricity Generating invests in coal mining firm.
newsitem.headline: Electricity Generating invests in coal mining firm.

text.p: Thai private power producer Electricity Generating Plc said on Tuesday it has invested in new mining firm, EGCO Mining Co Ltd, which will conduct coal exploration and mining.
In a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, Electricity Generating said it holds a 40 percent stake in EGCO Mining's registered capital of 50 million baht ($2 million).
The remaining owners are Asia Energy Development Co Ltd with 40 percent, J.B. Energy Co Ltd with 10 percent and SCF Finance and Securities with 10 percent, it said.
EGCO Mining will jointly invest with Indonesia's P.T. Borneo Indobara to develop and explore a coal mine in Indonesia.
EGCO Mining will have a 75 percent stake in the joint investment and the remaining shares will be owned by P.T. Borneo Indobara, it said.
Electricity Generating did not give the investment value of its joint project in Indonesia.
